question: In January 2025, which woman cricketer received the Polly Umrigar Award from the BCCI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Smriti Mandhana**, the Indian women's cricket team opener, was awarded the prestigious **Polly Umrigar Award** by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in January 2025.
 
• This award is given to recognize outstanding performances in international cricket during a particular season.
 
• Smriti Mandhana has been a consistent performer for India, excelling in all formats of the game and significantly contributing to the team's success.
 
• The Polly Umrigar Award is one of the most prestigious accolades in Indian cricket, named after former Indian cricketer Polly Umrigar, who was one of India's early cricketing stalwarts.
 
• Smriti Mandhana has previously won similar accolades, including the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year and ICC ODI Player of the Year awards, showcasing her exceptional talent and consistency on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Polly Umrigar Award:**

 
 
• It is presented annually by the BCCI to the best Indian international cricketer (male or female).
 
• The award is named after Polly Umrigar, a legendary Indian cricketer who played for India between 1948 and 1962.
 
• The winner receives a trophy and a monetary reward.
 
 
 
• **Smriti Mandhana's Achievements:**
 
 
• She was the youngest T20I captain for India when she led the team in 2019.
 
• Mandhana is the first Indian woman cricketer to score a double century in a one-day game (2013).
 
• She has been a key player in the Indian Premier League for Women and in international leagues such as the Women's Big Bash League (WBBL).
 
 
 
• **BCCI Women's Awards:**
 
 
• The BCCI has been actively recognizing the contributions of women cricketers through various awards.
 
• These awards aim to highlight the growing prominence of women's cricket in India and inspire future players.
 
 
 
• **Growth of Women's Cricket in India:**
 
 
• The Indian women's cricket team has witnessed significant growth in popularity, especially after reaching the ICC Women's World Cup final in 2017.
 
• Initiatives like the Women's IPL have further elevated the status of women's cricket in India.
 
• The performances of players like Smriti Mandhana, Harmanpreet Kaur, and Shafali Verma have played a pivotal role in this transformation.
